verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs says Scribe's captions, subtitles and editable transcripts are available "in Studio or via API". The API reference documents a broad feature surface: URL ingestion, diarization tuning, word- and character-level timestamps, multichannel output, export formats, natural-language transcript edits, async webhooks, zero-retention mode, and realtime WebSockets with Python and Node SDKs. However, no source states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, so parity is implied rather than demonstrated. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of UI-only editing and Studio workflows (such as manual transcript and timestamp editing), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
